name: Bal Ashrams
benefit: Free schooling, boarding and lodging, free bedding and clothing, recreational material, and medicines.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a social worker or the guardian of the eligible child.
1. The child should be an orphan or a destitute.
1. The child should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The child should not already be availing of the benefits of the scheme.
